extracted text: Rolled sheets of 7055 aluminium alloy with a thickness of 1.8 mm, with the chemical composition (wt%): Zn, 7.68, Mg 1.98, Cu, 2.21, Zr, 0.12, Fe < 0.12, Si < 0.10, Al, Bal., were used. The sheets were solution heat treated at 470 °C for 30 min in an air furnace, quenched in water (≈20 °C) and then artificially aged at 120 °C for 24 h and then at 160 °C for 6 h. The Vickers hardness of the aged sheets is 205 ± 3 HV3.
